description: This PHP source file generates the MoCA Diagnostics troubleshooting page, including fetching MoCA interface data, displaying device info, and rendering a network diagram with associated devices.

methods.name: div_mod
methods.description: Calculates quotient and remainder of division, returns an array [quotient, remainder].

methods.name: ajax_moca_diagnostics
methods.description: Performs AJAX request to fetch MoCA diagnostics data and renders the network diagram.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Renders the network diagram based on data received from AJAX.

methods.name: update_NC_AssociatedDevices
methods.description: Updates the MoCA nodes table and active/backup NC display with device data.

methods.name: moca_bonded_paths
methods.description: Determines path quality color based on PHY transmit rate and MoCA version.

methods.name: create_nodes_edges
methods.description: Creates nodes and edges data for visualization based on MoCA network structure.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys existing vis network instance if any.
